objective: Make KL Admin Release Now reliable and intelligible on BUKLOD desktop web without publishing any chapter, bypassing server approvals, or changing native runtime.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Inspected GitHub Main 3ead9e9a2ce707b10fa9c53aa17d39f3b1e5ebaf KLReaderScreen nested Pressable chapter admin actions and klDatabaseId arithmetic mapping. Read-only production Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu confirmed kl_admin_action_v1 returns JSONB ok:true and requires system_admin role, approved status, prepared preview, approved media, manuscript >=100 characters. Chapter 4 has non-legacy UUID, draft, no manuscript and one unapproved media; chapters 2-3 already released; chapter 1 draft. These are production DB observations, not live browser click/transport traces.
chosenApproach: Read the private admin RPC `kl_admin_list_v1` for exact per-episode server UUID and approved/preview/status data. Fail closed if unlisted, draft or already released; still let owner open release status and see explicit blockers. Before any action refetch server rows and lock against duplicate clicks; send exact UUID to existing authorized server RPC, verify ok:true and post-release admin+public-library result before claiming success. Split chapter-open Pressable from admin control siblings to prevent nested desktop-web button interactions. Preserve mandatory two-click release confirmation. Ensure the reader/progress/rewards and discussion use server-provided UUIDs after a chapter is released; retain the legacy formula only as fallback for pre-server/bundled chapters.
selectionRationale: New chapter 4 ID differs from legacy `klDatabaseId` sequence; source currently routes all admin actions to computed IDs. Chapter list also renders Release Now on drafts/nonexistent rows and nested clickable containers, creating false nonfunctional feedback. Server action requirements must remain enforced.
alternativeApproaches: Change Chapter 4 database UUID to match hardcoded formula: rejected, risks breaking media/approval references and external links.
Bypass preview/media/approval gates for Release: rejected, publishing integrity/security issue.
Auto-release all drafts to satisfy button: rejected, owner asked to fix function, not publish chapters.
Only change button color/tooltip: rejected, fails wrong database identity root cause.

Manuscripts, scenes, media review, KL reader unlock and chapter schedule unchanged
Admin cannot release chapter without approved status, prepared preview and approved media; server checks remain
Only current account can view admin row metadata; unauthorized users do not call private admin list
Same native/mobile chapter reader and existing RPC, no new database table or migration
Previous Main SOS, Wall, Cluster, ads, Quiz, Classroom, and unrelated DEV fixes untouched
Production Expo Hosting manual exact-SHA release separate from source merge
Existing bundled chapters continue working with legacy fallback ID if no server metadata is available

Draft/never-created/already-released chapters show useful blockers; Confirm disabled for blocked rows

Network or permission failure surfaces error, never reports false success
Story-focused Node tests, TypeScript and Expo web export gates pass
